name: Jimmy
source:
Ed's young nephew. He works the farm while he stays with his Uncle Ed. His uncle has tasked him with tending Sally, but this has proven to be difficult given the rising sexual frustrations and curiosities of a young man.

After Jimmy's mother died, he has developed desires for a nurturer, and this emotional deficit has heightened his curiosity in Sally and her comforting allure.
